current_cn: 幕末时期用于指称西方外国人的称呼，但并不属于阶级制度。然而，日本开放后，许多限制被强行取消，西方游客和商人涌入日本。其中许多最成功的人，主要是军火商，获得了与武士相当的地位，甚至被赋予了自己的日本名字和徽章。{newline}{newline}优点：无{newline}{newline}限制：无法玩

source: Your actions have started a war with {QUEST_GIVER.LINK}'s faction. {?QUEST_GIVER.GENDER}She{?}He{\\?} cancels your agreement and the quest is a failure.
current_cn: 你的行为已经引发了与 {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} 派系的战争。 {?QUEST_GIVER.GENDER}她{?}他{\?}取消你的协议，任务失败。

source: {QUEST_GIVER.LINK}, a retainer of the {QUEST_GIVER_FACTION} has told you that they need smoothbore Geweer for their upcoming military campaign. {?QUEST_GIVER.GENDER}She{?}He{\\?} wanted you to deliver {SMOOTHBORE_AMOUNT} Geweer guns and although it's not necessary, to provide {RIFLE_AMOUNT} Minieru rifles and {CARTRIDGE_AMOUNT} cartridge boxes. {?QUEST_GIVER.GENDER}she{?}he{\\?} would appreciate it.
current_cn: {QUEST_GIVER.LINK}，{QUEST_GIVER_FACTION} 的一名随从告诉您，他们需要滑膛蓋貝爾槍来应对即将到来的军事行动。 {?QUEST_GIVER.GENDER}她{?}他{\?} 希望你提供 {SMOOTHBORE_AMOUNT}蓋貝爾槍枪，尽管没有必要，但提供 {RIFLE_AMOUNT} 米涅步枪和 {CARTRIDGE_AMOUNT} 弹盒。 {?QUEST_GIVER.GENDER}她{?}他{\?} 将不胜感激。

source: I'll deliver {SMOOTHBORE_AMOUNT} Geweer muskets as soon as possible {?QUEST_GIVER.GENDER}lady{?}sir{\\?}, and try to find some Minieru and cartridges as you requested.
current_cn: 我会尽快交付{SMOOTHBORE_AMOUNT} 蓋貝爾槍步枪{?QUEST_GIVER.GENDER}女士{?}先生{\?}，并按照您的要求尽力找到一些米涅步枪和弹药筒。

source: {ISSUE_GIVER.LINK} a merchant from {ISSUE_GIVER_SETTLEMENT} has complained to you about not being able to sell foreign made firearms in the town. {?ISSUE_GIVER.GENDER}She{?}He{\\?} will pay {REWARD}{GOLD_ICON} for you to take the guns to another town. You have tasked {COMPANION.LINK} and {ALTERNATIVE_SOLUTION_TROOP_COUNT} men to smuggle {?ISSUE_GIVER.GENDER}her{?}his{\\?} goods to a “friend” in {TARGET_TOWN}. They will return to you in {RETURN_DAYS} days with a sizable sum of {REWARD}{GOLD_ICON}.
current_cn: {ISSUE_GIVER.LINK} 来自 {ISSUE_GIVER_SETTLEMENT} 的商人向您抱怨无法在镇上销售外国制造的枪支。 {?ISSUE_GIVER.GENDER}她{?}他{\?} 将支付 {REWARD}{GOLD_ICON} 让你把枪带到另一个城镇。您已指派 {COMPANION.LINK} 和 {ALTERNATIVE_SOLUTION_TROOP_COUNT} 人员将 {?ISSUE_GIVER.GENDER}她的{?}他的{\?} 货物走私给 {TARGET_TOWN} 的“朋友”。他们将在 {RETURN_DAYS} 天后返回给您，并携带相当大的金额 {REWARD}{GOLD_ICON}。

source: {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} a merchant from {QUEST_GIVER_SETTLEMENT} has complained to you about not being able to sell their stock of foreign guns because of the unfair local laws. {?QUEST_GIVER.GENDER}She{?}He{\\?} will pay {REWARD_AMOUNT}{GOLD_ICON} for you to take the guns to another town. You agreed to take {?QUEST_GIVER.GENDER}her{?}his{\\?} guns to {TARGET_HERO.LINK} in {TARGET_SETTLEMENT}.
current_cn: {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} 一位来自 {QUEST_GIVER_SETTLEMENT} 的商人向您抱怨，由于当地法律不公平，他们无法出售他们库存的外国枪支。 {?QUEST_GIVER.GENDER}她{?}他{\?} 将支付 {REWARD_AMOUNT}{GOLD_ICON} 让你把枪带到另一个城镇。您同意将 {?QUEST_GIVER.GENDER}她的{?}他的{\?} 枪带到 {TARGET_SETTLEMENT} 的 {TARGET_HERO.LINK}。

source: {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} sends {?QUEST_GIVER.GENDER}her{?}his{\\?} regards for a fine job done with the {REWARD}{GOLD_ICON} {?QUEST_GIVER.GENDER}she{?}he{\\?} promised.
current_cn: {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} 向 {?QUEST_GIVER.GENDER}她的{?}他的{\?} 致以问候，祝贺 {REWARD}{GOLD_ICON} {?QUEST_GIVER.GENDER}她{?}他{\?} 所承诺的工作做得很好。

source: You have failed to deliver {REQUESTED_AMOUNT} {.%}{?(REQUESTED_AMOUNT > 1)}rifles{?}rifle{\\?}{.%} to {TARGET_SETTLEMENT} in time as {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} asked you.
current_cn: 您未能按照 {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} 的要求及时将 {REQUESTED_AMOUNT} {.%}{?(REQUESTED_AMOUNT > 1)}步枪{?}步枪{\?}{.%} 交付给 {TARGET_SETTLEMENT}。

source: You could change this law, my {?PLAYER.GENDER}lady{?}lord{\\?}. All of us would be grateful. and we're willing to donate {REWARD}{GOLD_ICON} to show our thanks...
current_cn: 你可以改变这条法律，我的{?PLAYER.GENDER}女士{?}领主{\?}。我们所有人都会感激不尽。我们愿意捐赠 {REWARD}{GOLD_ICON} 以表示感谢......

source: My {?PLAYER.GENDER}lady{?}lord{\\?}, that would be very good. The artisans won't like it but hard-working merchants like me will be grateful to you.
current_cn: 我的{?PLAYER.GENDER}女士{?}领主{\?}，那就太好了。工匠们不会喜欢它，但像我这样勤劳的商人会感激你的。

source: My {?PLAYER.GENDER}lady{?}lord{\\?}, we heard that you wish to issue a decree allowing the sale of foreign weapons. This will devastate the business of our smithies who have toiled for generations. Please reconsider this.
current_cn: 我的{?PLAYER.GENDER}女士{?}领主{\?}，我们听说您希望颁布一项允许出售外国武器的法令。这将毁掉我们几代人辛苦劳作的铁匠们的生意。请重新考虑这一点。

source: That's your right, my {?PLAYER.GENDER}lady{?}lord{\\?}. But if you can't get the support of the artisans here when you next need it, well, don't say no one said anything.
current_cn: 这是你的权利，我的 {?PLAYER.GENDER}女士{?}领主{\?}。但是，如果您下次需要时无法获得这里工匠的支持，那么，请不要说没有人说什么。

source: My {?PLAYER.GENDER}lady{?}lord{\\?}, we have heard rumors that you have purchased foreign firearms from {QUEST_GIVER.NAME}.[ib:demure] Surely this cannot be true. Our laws require that only Japanese-made firearms may be bought or sold here.
current_cn: 我的{?PLAYER.GENDER}女士{?}领主{\?}，我们听说您从{QUEST_GIVER.NAME}.[ib:demure]购买了外国枪支，这当然不是真的。我们的法律规定，这里只能买卖日本制造的枪支。

source: Perhaps, my {?PLAYER.GENDER}lady{?}lord{\\?}, it was a mistake? If you were to relinquish the goods, it would avoid a situation that might appear, well, a bit unseemly.
current_cn: 也许，我的{?PLAYER.GENDER}女士{?}领主{\?}，这是一个错误？如果你放弃货物，就可以避免出现可能看起来有点不体面的情况。
这是一个公正的决定，我的 {?PLAYER.GENDER}女士{?}领主{\?}。

source: Respectfully, my {?PLAYER.GENDER}lady{?}lord{\\?}, I must protest this. But of course you are free to do what you will.
current_cn: 尊敬的，我的 {?PLAYER.GENDER}女士{?}领主{\?}，我必须对此表示抗议。但当然，你可以自由地做你想做的事。

source: Thank you my {?PLAYER.GENDER}lady{?}lord{\\?}. I am sure your men will take care of the problem.
current_cn: 谢谢你，我的 {?PLAYER.GENDER}女士{?}领主{\?}。我相信你的人会解决这个问题的。

source: Yes... {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} sent word to us. We are expecting the {.%}{RIFLES}{.%} that {?QUEST_GIVER.GENDER}she{?}he{\\?} had.
current_cn: 是的... {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} 给我们发了消息。我们期待 {?QUEST_GIVER.GENDER}她{?}他{\?} 拥有的 {.%}{RIFLES}{.%} 。

source: Have you brought {REQUESTED_AMOUNT} {.%}{?(REQUESTED_AMOUNT > 1)}rifles{?}rifle{\\?}{.%}? I have a fat purse of {REWARD}{GOLD_ICON} for you as promised.
current_cn: 你带了 {REQUESTED_AMOUNT} {.%}{?(REQUESTED_AMOUNT > 1)}步枪{?}步枪{\?}{.%} 了吗？正如我所承诺的，我有一个 {REWARD}{GOLD_ICON} 的大钱包给你。

source: Yes. I have the goods right here. I brought {REQUESTED_AMOUNT} {.%}{?(REQUESTED_AMOUNT > 1)}rifles{?}rifle{\\?}{.%} as we agreed.
current_cn: 是的。我这里有货。按照我们约定，我带了{REQUESTED_AMOUNT} {.%}{?(REQUESTED_AMOUNT > 1)}步枪{?}步枪{\?}{.%}。

source: Thank you, {?PLAYER.GENDER}madam{?}sir{\\?}, I think they will be enough.
current_cn: 谢谢您，{?PLAYER.GENDER}女士{?}先生{\?}，我想它们就足够了。

source: {ISSUEGIVER.LINK}, a merchant from {SETTLEMENT}, has told you about {?ISSUEGIVER.GENDER}her{?}his{\\?} recent problems with shishi radicals. {?ISSUEGIVER.GENDER}She{?}he{\\?} asked you to guard {?ISSUEGIVER.GENDER}her{?}his{\\?} foreign guest for a while and deal with any attackers. In return {?ISSUEGIVER.GENDER}she{?}he{\\?} offered you {GOLD}{GOLD_ICON} for each day your troops spend on escort duty.{newline}You agreed to lend {?ISSUEGIVER.GENDER}her{?}him{\\?} {NEEDED_MEN_COUNT} men. They should be enough to turn away most of the radicals. Your troops should return after {RETURN_DAYS} days.
current_cn: 来自{SETTLEMENT}的商人{ISSUEGIVER.LINK}向您讲述了{?ISSUEGIVER.GENDER}她的{?}他的{\?}最近的尊攘激进派的问题。 {?ISSUEGIVER.GENDER}她{?}他{\?}要求你暂时看守{?ISSUEGIVER.GENDER}她的{?}他的{\?}外宾并处理任何袭击者。作为回报，{?ISSUEGIVER.GENDER}她{?}他{\?} 为您的部队每天护送任务提供 {GOLD}{GOLD_ICON}。{newline}您同意借出 {?ISSUEGIVER.GENDER}她的{?}他{\?} {NEEDED_MEN_COUNT} 人员。它们应该足以赶走大多数激进分子。你的部队应该在 {RETURN_DAYS} 天后返回。

source: Your companion has protected the foreign merchant from {SETTLEMENT} as promised. {?ISSUE_GIVER.GENDER}She{?}He{\\?} was happy with your work.
current_cn: 你的同伴已经按照承诺保护了外国商人免受{SETTLEMENT}的侵害。 {?ISSUE_GIVER.GENDER}她{?}他{\?} 对您的工作感到满意。

source: {ISSUE_GIVER.LINK}, a merchant from {SETTLEMENT}, has told you about {?ISSUE_GIVER.GENDER}her{?}his{\\?} recent problems with shishi radicals. {?ISSUE_GIVER.GENDER}She{?}He{\\?} asked you to guard {?ISSUE_GIVER.GENDER}her{?}his{\\?} foreign guest for a while and deal with any attackers. In return {?ISSUE_GIVER.GENDER}she{?}he{\\?} offered you {GOLD}{GOLD_ICON} denars for each day you spend on escort duty.{newline}You have agreed to guard him yourself until he visits {NUMBER_OF_SETTLEMENTS} settlements.
current_cn: 来自{SETTLEMENT}的商人{ISSUE_GIVER.LINK}向您讲述了{?ISSUE_GIVER.GENDER}她的{?}他的{\?}最近的尊攘激进派的问题。 {?ISSUE_GIVER.GENDER}她{?}他{\?}要求你暂时看守{?ISSUE_GIVER.GENDER}她的{?}他的{\?}外宾并处理任何袭击者。作为回报，{?ISSUE_GIVER.GENDER}她{?}他{\?} 为您每天执行护送任务提供 {GOLD}{GOLD_ICON} 第纳尔。{newline}您已同意亲自看守他，直到他访问 {NUMBER_OF_SETTLEMENTS} 定居点。

source: {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} says that a {MALE_LESSER_NOBLE_TITLE} named {MALE_LESSER_NOBLE_NAME} is stirring up unrest in the countryside. {?QUEST_GIVER.GENDER}She{?}He{\\?} asked you to disperse {MALE_LESSER_NOBLE_NAME}'s band using whatever means necessary before the movement gets enough support.
current_cn: {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} 说，一个名为 {MALE_LESSER_NOBLE_NAME} 的 {MALE_LESSER_NOBLE_TITLE} 正在乡村煽动骚乱。 {?QUEST_GIVER.GENDER}她{?}他{\?} 要求您在运动获得足够支持之前使用任何必要的手段驱散 {MALE_LESSER_NOBLE_NAME} 的乐队。

source: {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} has left {KINGDOM}. Your agreement with {?QUEST_GIVER.GENDER}her{?}him{\\?} has been canceled.
current_cn: {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} 已离开 {KINGDOM}。您与 {?QUEST_GIVER.GENDER}她的{?}他{\?} 的协议已取消。
您好，{?PLAYER.GENDER}夫人{?}先生{\?}。我可以帮你吗？

source: I can't let you in. My {?SETTLEMENT_OWNER.GENDER}Lady{?}Lord{\\?} {SETTLEMENT_OWNER.NAME} would be furious.
current_cn: 我不能让你进来。我的 {?SETTLEMENT_OWNER.GENDER}Lady{?}Lord{\?} {SETTLEMENT_OWNER.NAME} 会生气的。
当然，{?PLAYER.GENDER}女士{?}先生{\?}。进去吧。

source: Ah! I was looking for this all day. How good of you to bring it back {?PLAYER.GENDER}madam{?}sir{\\?}. Well, now that I know what an honest {?PLAYER.GENDER}lady{?}man{\\?} you are, there can be no harm in letting you inside for a look. Go in.... Just so you know, though -- I'll be hanging onto the keys, in case you were thinking about undoing anyone's chains.
current_cn: 啊!我一整天都在找这个。你把它带回来真是太好了{?PLAYER.GENDER}女士{?}先生{\?}。好吧，现在我知道你是一个多么诚实的{?PLAYER.GENDER}女士{?}男子{\?}，让你进去看看也没什么坏处。进去……不过，让你知道——我会抓住钥匙，以防你想解开任何人的锁链。
当然，我的{?PLAYER.GENDER}女士{?}领主{\?}。

source: You have heard of the Zokuron-ha, no doubt. Men who no longer serve our lord, but instead interpret his will until it no longer resembles his own. It is a quieter coup than steel in the night, but no less real.{newline}{newline}Chōshū cannot afford to be governed by shadows wearing official seals. So I have begun what some will call an uprising, but is in truth an attempt to save our lord.{newline}{newline}I am not here to beg you, {PLAYER.NAME}. I am here because {?PLAYER.GENDER}women{?}men{\\?} like you do not stand safely on the fence forever. You either act while there is still something worth acting for... or you watch it rot past saving.[if:grave][ib:warrior]
current_cn: 毫无疑问，你听说过 Zokuron-ha。这些人不再侍奉我们的主，而是解释他的意志，直到它不再像他自己的意志。这是比夜里的钢铁更安静的政变，但同样真实。{newline}{newline}长州不能被戴着官方印章的阴影所统治。所以我开始了一些人所说的起义，但实际上是为了拯救我们的领主。{newline}{newline}我不是来这里求你的，{PLAYER.NAME}。我来这里是因为 {?PLAYER.GENDER}women{?}men{\?} 像你一样不会永远安全地站在栅栏上。你要么在仍有值得为之行动的事情时行动……要么眼睁睁地看着它腐烂而无法挽救。[if:grave][ib:warrior]
